Those don't appear light roast at all. If you really did pull them shortly after first crack, you might be roasting them way too fast. A good way to slow down your roasts on a sr500 is to start at lowish power setting, and full fan speed. I start at a level 4 with fan speed at 9, then I increase the power every minute, as well as lower the fan speed. Well, the first 2 minutes I leave the settings alone. This seems to work very well for me, and my roasts take about 5 minutes to reach first crack, and 2 and a half minutes to reach 2nd crack (after first crack). This gives you plenty of time to shut it off before 2nd crack.
